prompts.a: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: concept screenshot for approval ONLY, for the Sega Mega Drive game Plaguefall. This is an actual retro game screen design, not a photographed monitor, not a marketing sheet. Landscape 10:7 aspect ratio, full-bleed 320x224 logical pixels enlarged to 1280x896 using crisp uniform nearest-neighbor pixel blocks. Authentic restrained 16-bit pixel art, small limited palette, no smooth gradients, no vector styling, no 3D render, no antialiasing. Input image 1 is the current radio dialogue screenshot: retain the game's visual language, readable bitmap lettering and the EXACT two character portrait identities. Image 2 is Damião's original 48x48 portrait (cangaceiro with hat, at left); image 3 is Padre's original 48x48 portrait (gray hair, no hat, headset, at right). Preserve these two portraits faithfully as pixel sprite inserts, same native scale, never redraw into modern illustration, no extra characters. Replace ALL visible level ground/church scenery with a dedicated dark sci-fi holodeck communication interior in the game's Brazilian industrial cyberpunk aesthetic. Dark iron, oxidized copper accents, sparse amber circuit lines, black glass monitor surfaces. ALL interface lettering in yellow / amber, dialogue text bright yellow. Main dialogue monitor background PURE BLACK and unpatterned behind text. Four readable lines with 8x8 bitmap font, exact dialogue text: "DAMIÃO, AQUI É O PADRE." / "SEGURE O PÁTIO. TEM GENTE" / "FUGINDO PELO FUNDO." Header exact: "RÁDIO / COMUNIDADE". Display speaker name "PADRE" and page "1/2". Footer exact: "A: AVANÇAR" and "START: PULAR". No English text, no option label within game image, no logo, no watermark. No stage backdrop, no HUD health, no weapons. COMPOSITION A — INDUSTRIAL HOLODECK TERMINAL: close, straight-on communication terminal filling almost the whole screen. Most readable and pragmatic design. Keep Damião's portrait at upper left with small black listening window to its right, name DAMIÃO, status ESCUTANDO. Keep Padre's portrait at lower right framed in dark copper. A single very large black rectangular dialogue monitor spans the lower-middle screen to the left of Padre with bright yellow dialogue. Broad riveted mechanical bezel in charcoal/oxidized copper and restrained amber trim. At top and side edges glimpse a dedicated dark holodeck wall grid, never the level. The black screen area dominates, minimal clutter, text generous and orderly. Reuse the existing opposing portrait arrangement at 48x48 logical pixels. Native logical portrait anchors approximately (16,40) and (248,144).
